title: unforge.retract.v0
description: Record returned by UNFORGE Retract. Local process. No server. ok: true means a UNFORGE-RETRAIT-v1 binds to the card (same id, card_id, empreinte, materiau). History stays. Not a delete. Not a match (unforge-check). Not a print (unforge-press). Signature is not opened here.

ok.description: Withdrawal binds to the published proof, or a brouillon was written. Not a file-match verdict. Not a seal. Not a burn.

empreinte.description: Card fingerprint copied from the proof. Not recomputed. Not a seal.

materiau.description: RETRAIT|{id}|{card_id}|{empreinte}. Signed on QUANTUM, not here.

signe.description: signature field is non-empty. Presence only — this repo does not open it.

signature_ouverte.description: Retract does not verify Ed25519 or UFHY1. Check does.

histoire.const: la preuve reste ; le retrait s'ajoute

retract.description: Path of the .retrait.json when written or bound.
